output: html_document
---


```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)


##CIS1
file_path <- "CIS1_kmer_abun.txt"
data <- read.table(file_path, header=TRUE, sep="", row.names=1)

data <- t(data)

data <- as.data.frame(data)

data$Position <- c("-6", "-5", "-4", "-3", "-2", "-1", "1", "2", "3")  # Modify this based on your actual positions

df_melt <- melt(data, id.vars = 'Position', variable.name = 'Dy_seq', value.name = 'Frequency')

df_melt$Position <- factor(data$Position, levels = c("-6", "-5", "-4", "-3", "-2", "-1", "1", "2", "3", "4"))

df_melt$Dy_seq <- factor(df_melt$Dy_seq, levels = c( "GG", "GA", "AG", "TG", "CA", "CG", 
                                                     "AA", "AC","GC", "GT", "TA", 
                                                    "AT","CC", "TC", "CT", "TT"))

ggplot(df_melt, aes(x = as.factor(Position), y = Frequency, fill = Dy_seq)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', colour = "black") +  # Add black outline to each bar
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(  '#90dbf4','#bee9e8', '#ffc2d1', '#F28C9D', 
                                 'lightgrey','lightgrey', 'lightgrey', 'lightgrey', 'lightgrey', 
                                 'lightgrey', 'lightgrey', 'lightgrey','#9EAAE0', '#b8d0eb','#ede7b1', '#F3E065' )) + 
  labs(title = 'CIS1: Target Read', 
       x = 'Position', 
       y = 'Nucleotide Frequency') + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),  # Center the title and set font size
    panel.grid.major = element_blank()  
  )


```
